description: A cookie checker that shows what a website sets, and whether Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite are on. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

url.description: The public website to check, for example https://example.com. A bare hostname is read as https. The page is fetched as a normal browser would and every Set-Cookie header it returns is parsed and judged. Private, loopback and non-http addresses are refused.

name: cookie_checker
title: Cookie Checker
